reviewer: ChatGPT Codex and Astra direct image review

findings.description: Direct V215 crouch and sit renders show no visible lap-coverage improvement over V214. The inner layer covers both thighs nearly to the knees, while the outer apron folds beside and between them; the lilac hem forms sharp points below the knees and leaves the lap uncovered.
Standing profiles still show a mid-thigh bend and forward hem projection. Prone still doubles the front fabric beneath the hips, with several folds under the near hand.

nextAction: Trace the V215 left-front row reported at zero orientation-safe scale through the standing-to-sit transition. Check whether its motion stops where the hem slips below the thigh, identify the row displacement and neighboring face orientation constraint, then change that specific deformation method. Verify a continuous lilac hem across both thighs in sit and crouch. Fit, production rig/weights, Shape Key response, Unity/VRChat behavior, package and release remain unverified.
